description.en: TimeSage-EV evaluates LLM agents on time series analysis tasks in evolving environments, using 60 institutional scenarios across 6 domains with 1,485 scenario-period QA pairs. Agents receive data and reports, with withheld target releases as ground truth, assessing state identification, data summarization, and outlook reasoning.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing time series QA benchmarks rely on fixed snapshots, but real-world data is released periodically, affecting conclusions. TimeSage-EV fills this gap by evaluating agentic temporal validity and cutoff-aware evidence use, providing a decision-value for deploying LLM agents in high-stakes domains where data updates matter.
